card.name: Leading digits in references and ranges
card.fires_on: Mostly the first digit of a number in citations, confidence intervals or year ranges, and sometimes punctuation in journal references. Also scattered single words like 'will' or 'healthcare'.

modes.label: Digits in numeric ranges
modes.description: First digit of a number inside parentheses, intervals or year spans.

modes.label: Citation punctuation
modes.description: Period or dash in journal citation strings after volume or page numbers.

modes.label: Scattered words
modes.description: Single ordinary words in running text with no shared theme.
